comparison_or_audit.report:
Aggregate of 5 evidence fragments; not acceptance.

Synthesis of 5 fresh source-only fragments. F1 cache.rs: reuse_or_collision verifies content identity but not modes; a same-named same-content file with writable or setuid modes can be accepted as immutable. Staging pid+counter under trusted parent allows same-uid pre-create/replace, mitigated by O_NOFOLLOW/RENAME_NOREPLACE. open_root TOCTOU mitigated by descriptor-relative open and dev/ino compare. Missing hex/nix/tempfile deps and whole-tree context; no cross-fragment discrepancy. F2: PackageSources lacks --unshare-net, so proxy is bypassable; inspect_and_promote_cache lacks manifest checksum, uses non-atomic copy, only rejects magic, tested promote unused, enabling cache poisoning. File/scratch size checks scan immediate files only, allowing subdirectory evasion. Network proxy handles HTTP only, not HTTPS CONNECT, and reads 4096 bytes, risking truncation/smuggling. Decision needed. F3: origin parser blocks NUL/percent/query/fragment/whitespace/traversal but allows non-NUL control chars in path; is_numeric_ipv4_alias over-rejects all-hex hostnames with a digit, e.g. 1abc; is_public_address misses IPv4-compatible IPv6 ::a.b.c.d, so ::127.0.0.1 may be public. probe.rs sets new_session/parent_death_signal true untested and finds bwrap via PATH/is_file without symlink/executable pinning, leaving TOCTOU/symlink risk if later execution does not re-verify. validation.rs checks immediate writable-scope symlinks only, not nested escapes, and rejects destinations containing 'unapproved'. Missing Origin/Scheme/MAX_URL_BYTES/RequestKind/TransportPolicyMode and rest of validation network/phase checks. F4: Cargo phases validated with argv/env/grants/vendored mounts. validate_source accepts registry identity equal to sha256(name) in addition to derived origin-bound identity then returns derived, weakening identity binding and allowing source-identity substitution. canonical_production_origin falls back to origin::parse after parse_production; origin module missing, so scheme/loopback permissiveness unverified. grants_by_destination BTreeMap silently drops duplicate destinations; upstream uniqueness not in fragment, though tests cover overlap. Missing origin module, MAX constants, earlier duplicate checks, full truncated test. Decision needed. F5: tests only, no implementation. Tests assert fail-closed legacy requests, administrative PATH/grant rejection, reserved /.galla-sandbox, loopback/numeric IP source rejection, golden source identities, schema enumerants, read-only toolchain mounts. executable_executes_successfully_on_valid_request spawns galla-runner with env_clear and open stdin pipe, expecting nested sandbox detection returncode 3 and no stdout. Missing validation, Bubblewrap enforcement, mount filtering, and host permission preservation source prevents source-level security verification. No local discrepancy. Overall decision_required true due to F2 and F4.
